targetCompanyImage.name: CleanCapital Holdings, LLC
targetCompanyImage.description: CleanCapital Holdings LLC develops, acquires, owns and operates distributed solar and energy-storage projects across the United States. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the platform serves commercial, industrial, institutional, utility and public-sector counterparties through contracted clean-energy assets. Current company materials report more than 350 projects and approximately 500 MW, with over US$1.5 billion invested. BlackRock Renewable Power Group funds made a direct investment in 2019, but that period is historical and the exact stake and exit date are not publicly disclosed. Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment in 2021 and remains the only named current institutional backer; its exact percentage is not publicly disclosed. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a GIP ownership period. CleanCapital sold the 120 MW Nottingham development in April 2026 as an asset-level transaction and no platform sale or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

milestones.event: Funds managed by BlackRock's Renewable Power Group made a direct investment in CleanCapital; the exact fund, stake and later exit timing were not publicly disclosed.
Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment and US$300 million commitment; CleanCapital also became sole owner of the 46.9 MW portfolio previously financed with BlackRock.
CleanCapital acquired a 40-asset, 22.7 MW portfolio from Kendall Sustainable Infrastructure and secured further equity investment.
CleanCapital announced the acquisition of a 25 MWh storage portfolio from Pacifico.
